requirements.body: While the operator is in `standard` profile, the system shall expose only consumer-grade features.
While the operator is in `advanced` profile, the system shall additionally expose engineer-grade surfaces (Swarm GUI, FlowEngine inspector, compose editor).
While the operator is in `all_in_one` profile, the system shall additionally enable managed-interface DHCP (per Article VI).
The system shall hide UI surfaces disabled by the current profile from the dashboard navigation menu (component `dashboard/src/components/settings/AccessProfileSettings.vue` controls visibility).
While the operator is in `standard` profile, the system shall hide the Swarm GUI components (`dashboard/src/components/swarm/SwarmOverview.vue` + `StackList.vue`).
When the operator opens the profile-switcher (`dashboard/src/components/settings/ProfilesTab.vue`), the system shall display a clear summary of what each profile enables.
While the workflow runs, the system shall surface per-step progress to the dashboard via `dashboard/src/components/settings/ProfileSwitchProgressModal.vue` (CGC-verified shipped).

acceptance.scenario: Default profile after first-boot is standard
Switching to advanced activates Swarm GUI
Switching to all_in_one enables DHCP with managed interface
DHCP enable rejected when profile != all_in_one
Switch progress surfaces in the modal
